audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was credited to Ryze and level 2 called 'Skill', directly contradicting whys[0] ('Tryndamere auto-crits you in that approach and you have no answer') and whys[1] ('he can begin a crit string before your empowered Q fires back'). First item and two items were credited to Tryndamere although whys[5] and whys[6] describe your combo becoming the threat.
audit.why: Tryndamere owns levels 1-4 outright and the late game is a mutual coin-flip decided by whether Undying Rage is up. Packet: Tryndamere x4, Ryze, Skill, Skill, on a 47.91% lane.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 1 -> Tryndamere, rows 5 and 6 -> Skill, as matched full/content pairs with ratings; phases[6].why rewritten so it stops promising you out-DPS everyone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Undying Rage was given as a flat '110s cooldown' in wants.you[2], whys[6] and spikes[3].text, and whys[6] then told you to 'commit only with the ability up' — the reverse of the correct instruction.
audit.why: Riot's value is 120/100/80. The rank matters more than the number: an 80-second R at rank 3 changes how often you get a kill window from 'once a wave cycle' to 'constantly denied', and telling a player to commit while his R is available is how the combo gets dumped into a 1-HP immortal.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten with 120s at rank 1 / 80s at rank 3 and the commit condition corrected to 'while it is down'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mocking Shout appears nowhere on the page, despite being the ability that decides whether you escape. Riot's text: it reduces surrounding champions' Attack Damage, and 'Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced'. Spinning Slash's range (650) and cooldown (12/11/10/9/8) were also never given.
audit.why: The slow is conditional on facing — a Ryze who backs away facing him takes only the AD cut, while one who turns and runs is slowed into the crit string. That is a free counterplay the page withheld, and it matters more here than anywhere because Ryze has no dash.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and report[5].t now state the back-turned condition; dontsFull[0].d gives Spinning Slash's real range and cooldown.

audit.why: The needs-antiheal interaction (Bloodlust consuming Fury to heal) is already covered by report[8].t's anti-heal line.

edits.before: Seraph's online — you out-DPS and out-tank everyone in extended fights. Side-lane and Warp to every fight.
edits.after: Seraph's makes the combo near-permanent, but Undying Rage still buys him five seconds to answer.

edits.before: Five seconds unkillable — save your kill damage for after it ends. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Mocking Shout slows you only if your back is turned — face him while you retreat and it is just an AD cut.

edits.before: Track Tryndamere’s Undying Rage: Five seconds unkillable — save your kill damage for after it ends. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Undying Rage (120s at rank 1, 80s at rank 3) and Mocking Shout: it only slows you while your back is turned.

edits.before: That’s Tryndamere’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Spinning Slash is 650 range on 12s at rank 1 — that is his whole gap-close.

edits.before: At full build your burst can kill him but Undying Rage forces you to track the 110s timer; commit only with the ability up — never dump combo into his 1-HP window.
edits.after: At full build your burst kills him, but Undying Rage runs 120s at rank 1 and drops to 80s at rank 3 — commit only while it is down, never into his 1-HP window.

edits.before: At 2+ items your Flux cascade melts Tryndamere in a full combo — but his Undying Rage forces you to track the 110s cooldown or waste your burst window.
edits.after: At 2+ items your Flux cascade melts him in a full combo — but Undying Rage is 120s at rank 1 and only 80s at rank 3, so track the rank, not one number.

edits.before: Track Undying Rage's 110s cooldown and commit your full combo only after it has expired
edits.after: Track Undying Rage — 120s at rank 1, 80s at rank 3 — and commit your combo only when it is down

notes: Both packet suspectNames hits ('Use Spinning Slash', 'Pop Undying Rage') are FALSE POSITIVES — correct names with a verb in front. Left as unverified: whys[1], spikes[0].text and content 'early' all claim Spinning Slash 'reaches you through the root animation' / 'crosses your root'. Whether a dash cast beats an in-flight Rune Prison, or continues through a root applied mid-dash, is exactly the animation-priority question this data set says is not in Riot's text, so I did not rewrite or endorse those lines. The 'late' field also still carries the wrong 110s figure; it did not rewrite inside the band alongside the other three.
